subject: Trial extension + staggered credit release for Nova Labs pilot
messages:
From: Maria Rodriguez <maria@novalabs.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot credits + 90-day trial extension

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and cost numbers. We're ramping a small internal pilot and would like to request 75k token-equivalent in trial credits plus a 90-day extension on the free trial to align with our QA window.

Two asks:
- Credit amount: 75k tokens, disbursed in two tranches tied to milestones below.
- Trial extension: push trial expiry out by 90 days so we can complete integration testing.

Proposed milestone schedule:
1) Integration sign-off (internal): release 30% of credits
2) Pilot performance review (3 weeks after start): release remaining 70%

We can sign a simple MOU and share the milestone readouts. Can you advise next steps and whether this fits Redwood's pilot credit policy?

Regards,
Maria Rodriguez
Head of Product, Nova Labs
attachments: nova-product-overview.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodai.com>
To: Maria Rodriguez <maria@novalabs.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodai.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot credits + 90-day trial extension

Thanks Maria — great to hear the demo landed well. Looping in Marissa and Karthik to scope the credit details and approval path.

Marissa / Karthik, quick summary and ask: Nova Labs is requesting 75k tokens and a 90-day extension. They propose a two-tranche release (30% / 70%) tied to integration sign-off and a short pilot review. Their use case is inference-heavy search reranking (short sequences) — should be low-cost for us but important to demonstrate reliability under their QA.

Questions for the approvals thread:
- OK to approve 75k with the two-stage release?
- Legal/do we want a simple MOU (DocuSign) or a one-off credit agreement?
- Any objections on the 90-day trial extension?

If we greenlight, I can send the MOU and DocuSign link and track via HubSpot (see deal id).

-Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodai.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: pilot credits + 90-day trial extension

Jonas — thanks for the summary. I'm fine approving this as a conditional pilot credit. A few guardrails I'd like in place:
- Split the 75k into 25k (first tranche) / 50k (second tranche) — slightly different split to ensure they hit a meaningful integration before larger spend.
- MOU should include: acceptance of data retention terms, that they won’t use credits for benchmarking against competitors, and a milestone deliverable (integration test checklist).
- Finance wants the credit to be timeboxed to 120 days after the first tranche release (so credits expire if unused).

Karthik — can you confirm there's capacity on our side to support them in the requested window and if any special routing (region) is needed? Also, please attach the MOU template I can edit.

I’ll draft the MOU and send a DocuSign if we confirm capacity.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Lead | Redwood Inference
attachments: MOU-staggered-credits.pdf

Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 14:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pilot credits + 90-day trial extension

All good from infra — we have capacity in us-west region and can provision a dedicated sandbox pool for their pilot (no SLA). No special routing required. The 120-day expiry window on credits is reasonable.

One operational note: we’ll need a single point of contact for the milestone sign-offs (suggest Maria) and a lightweight evaluation doc for the pilot review (I can share a template).

Karthik

Hi Maria — good news: we can approve a conditional credit package. Summary of terms below (I’ll send this as an MOU via DocuSign once you confirm):
- Total credits: 75k token-equivalent
- Disbursement: 25k on integration sign-off; 50k after pilot performance review (~3 weeks after start)
- Trial extension: 90 days from date of first tranche release
- Credit expiry: credits must be used within 120 days from first tranche release
- Region: us-west sandbox pool (no SLA)
- Required: signed MOU and single point-of-contact for milestone sign-offs
